meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 WhatsApp 通道以原生 Baileys 适配器接入：拷贝适配器与格式化技能、注册通道、安装依赖、构建并跑注册测试。安装前先确认用专用号还是个人号，之后扫码或配对码一次性关联设备。
howto.when: 当你要求为项目添加 WhatsApp 通道时触发；进入安装前强制先做号码安全确认（专用号或个人号），选个人号会先给出账号被暂停或封禁的风险提示并要你确认。

say.text: 帮我把 WhatsApp 通道接进来
say.note: 会先问用专用号还是个人号

say.text: 我要用配对码方式关联 WhatsApp
say.note: 显示 8 位配对码，不需要摄像头

say.text: 我用自己的常用号，继续
say.note: 先弹账号风险警告，确认后才继续

howto.what_en: After install, Claude adds a WhatsApp channel via the native Baileys adapter: it copies the adapter, registers it, installs pinned deps, builds and runs the registration test. It first checks number safety, then links by QR or pairing code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a WhatsApp channel. It first requires a number safety check (dedicated or personal number); choosing a personal number shows an account-ban risk warning first.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp channel to my project
say_en.note: It first asks dedicated or personal number

say_en.text: Link WhatsApp with a pairing code
say_en.note: Uses an 8-character code instead of a QR scan
Shows the account-risk warning and asks to confirm
